responsibility: This header declares GCC’s SSA relation framework used alongside range queries. It defines relation_kind codes, helper predicates and transforms, the abstract relation_oracle interface for registering and querying relations and equivalence sets by basic block, iterator support for traversing full and partial equivalences, the relation_trio packing helper used by range operators, and the value_relation wrapper for manipulating individual SSA-to-SSA relations. It is the public API for relational reasoning infrastructure that complements scalar range analysis.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public relational API and data types—relation_kind, relation_oracle, iterators, relation_trio, and value_relation—while the companion .cc file defines the semantics tables and concrete oracle behavior.
